svg.title: FC Laranjeiras
svg.desc: Futebol Clube Laranjeiras (BR-4), Rio de Janeiro, Brazil — Football Architect. Historic heraldic football crest with Christ the Redeemer, Sugarloaf Mountain and cable car, sea waves, a hibiscus and the letters F, C and L. Approved colors: #00452A and #F1EEE5. Outer shield and central cartouche are mirrored around the vertical axis; the different city emblems in each quadrant are intentionally not mirror images.
